# The District by Navilu

> 226 BMRDA approved, Karnataka RERA registered villa plots (RERA PRM/KA/RERA/1251/308/PR/250825/008029) in a tropical themed layout at Nosennuru Gollahalli, Jigani Hobli, Anekal Taluk, South Bengaluru 562106. Developed by Naville Estates LLP (Navilu). Internal roads, drains, electricity and water are complete; plots range from about 1,052 to 2,192 sq ft.

## Project
- [Home page](https://thedistrictbynavilu.com/): approved master plan, plot availability, pricing and EMI calculator, amenities, location and FAQs
- [BMRDA approved layout plan (PDF)](https://thedistrictbynavilu.com/the-district-bmrda-approved-layout-plan.pdf)
